create.name: Empty Gate Zen Center
create.bio:
Empty Gate Zen Center is a Korean Zen community in Berkeley, California, belonging to the Kwan Um School of Zen. Its roots go back to 1977, when Ezra and Diana Clark met Zen Master Seung Sahn; a year later a house on Arch Street became a public, residential centre. Jeff Kitzes, who first sat a retreat there in 1979, has been guiding teacher since 1992 and received transmission from Seung Sahn in 2001 under the name Bon Soeng, meaning 'original nature'. Jason Quinn JDPSN, a former abbot of the Providence Zen Center, and Marshall White JDPSN also teach.

Practice now centres on a dharma room at 2200 Parker Street, with sittings most days of the week, many of them also on Zoom, and a Wednesday evening talk by Zen Master Bon Soeng that suits newcomers. The centre has two branches: a Boise group meeting at the Boise Buddhist Center since 2019, and the Cold Mountain Zen Center in Fairbanks, Alaska, which joined in 2025. Retreats lasting one, three or eight days run through the year, and the YouTube channel carries hundreds of short talk excerpts.

courses.title: Three Day Retreat with Marshall White JDPSN
courses.description: A three-day silent retreat of sitting and walking meditation, chanting and work periods, led by Marshall White JDPSN at the Berkeley centre, with an option to join online.
courses.price: Sustaining Level: $60 per day/ $30 Sunday (10% discount for members $54/$27)

courses.title: Eight Day Retreat
courses.description: The centre's longest retreat of the year, taught by Zen Master Bon Soeng together with Marshall White JDPSN, in Berkeley and online, with a full daily timetable of sitting, walking, chanting and work.
courses.price: Sustaining Level: $60 per day/ $30 Sunday (10% discount for members $54/$27)

free_resources.title: Weekly Practice Schedule
free_resources.description: Morning and evening sittings in Berkeley and Boise through the week, many also on Zoom, with chanting, walking meditation and a Saturday circle talk.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Evening Dharma Talk
free_resources.description: The suggested first visit for newcomers in Berkeley: a short orientation, evening chanting, sitting and a talk by Zen Master Bon Soeng, in person or on Zoom.

free_resources.title: Empty Gate Blog
free_resources.description: Written teachings from the centre on sitting practice, acceptance and happiness.
